title: Forms
intro: A record edited in group sheets, a long create form and a command dialog, over a fake backend that answers 422 and 409.
accountsHint: Open an account, edit one of its groups, then try the e-mail taken{'@'}example.com, or use “A colleague changed it” and save a group.
colleagueDone: Someone else saved this account: your next save is stale.
statusMessage: Archiving needs a reason. Setting the status it already has is refused by the server.
loadFailed: The accounts could not be loaded.
stale: The account was changed by someone else. It was read again; check your changes and save again.

groups.identity_locked: The identification of an archived account cannot change.

offer.quantityMin: Enter a quantity of at least 1.
offer.title: Title
offer.titleRequired: The title is required in Croatian.

dates.title: Dates and times
dates.intro: Typed entry first (try 30.9., +7, today, 1435); a calendar popover on wide screens and a half sheet with wheels on phones.
dates.deliveryHint: Delivery day: typed, or picked; the shortcuts include the app's own.
dates.longLabel: Date and time of the test drive and the handover

events.title: Blur, blank zero and the chosen value
events.link: Blur, blank zero and the chosen value
events.intro: A VIN checked when the field is left, a cost row where 0 reads as not set, and a colour select with its swatch on the chosen value.
events.vinHint: Leave the field to check it.

pickers.title: Pickers and translations
pickers.intro: Pickers with photo rows in a narrow column, and a translations row with a flag before each language.
pickers.narrowHint: The list is at least 20rem wide and opens under the field; on a phone it spans the screen.
pickers.wide: A short field in a wide row
pickers.translationsHint: A flag before each language: in the control while editing, before the value while reading.

options.title: Options that load
options.intro: Selects whose options come from the server: the model from the make, the equipment from the model.
options.demoHint: Requests made so far: {count}. Change the make while the models load: the older answer is ignored.
options.vehicleHint: Pick a make, then open the model while it loads. Switch Requests fail on, change the make, and press Try again after switching it off.
options.numbersHint: Year and coordinates show no thousands separator; the last field is grouped for comparison.
options.recordsHint: One record dialog for new and edit: discard guard, success toast, and Save and add another.
options.name: Name

section.title: A section edited in place
section.intro: Save is disabled until something changes, there is no Cancel, a hidden label still names its chips, and a postal code takes five digits.
section.name: Name
section.hint: Type a postal code longer than five digits, or paste one: the extra digits are not taken.

steps.title: Steps and questions
steps.intro: A long step in a phone sheet opens at its top; a command asks before it runs.
steps.name: Name
steps.askBody: The vehicle moves to the archive on {date}. This cannot be undone.
